title: Extract indexed tilemap pointers
changes: Extend the observed tilemap resource with eight authenticated pointer words used by the original indexed reader, preserving outside guest indices and existing neighboring resources.
validation: Wine source/disassembly e197-tilemap-source-wrir7wj7 authenticates the selected words and identifies the original indexed load. Wine e197-tilemap-wine-i23_yk35 preserves 122 other resources, rejects coherent edits, verifies mirrored/mixed reads and compares the original interpreter and compiled five-instruction reader for ten indices with equal full state and guest clock.
Wine e197-tilemap-cli-wine-q7a_34j2 creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: The reader log contains a D-Bus pending-call assertion before successful completion; the Wine host defect is tracked separately. Ordinary use and the seven other pointed-to payloads remain unproved, as do other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows. No performance measurements were performed.
